# **Purpose**

The purpose of the science board is to interface with several on board and off board sensors. It should communicate with these sensors in order to receive their data. It then should send that information over CAN. Sensors will be picked out by EHW and ESW.

# **Requirements**

- The board must be small enough to mount onto the science system  
- The board must be able to be mounted  
- The sensors must meet the specifications that astrobio sets  
  - They must sense at the appropriate range  
  - They must be able to work at temperatures up to 120 F   
- The MCU needs to be able to communicate with the sensors via the sensor’s protocol and communicate with the rest of the rover with CAN  
- It must be powered by 36V (maybe lower as everything on it will be 5V)

# **Components** 

MCU: STM32G431CBT6

- [datasheet](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stm32g431c6.pdf)

CAN FD Transceiver: TCAN1044VDRQ1

- [datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tcan1044-q1.pdf?ts=1752649566659)

# **Interfaces**

The main interface is with Science Payload (SP). It is mounted on the auger. The SP system may change this year, so the image below may not be accurate. Please look at PDR/CDR for more up information when those come out. 

The board is in the green block that is near the beam. The green top plate on top of the system is where offboard sensors are mounted. Again, subject to change for 2027\.  
![][image1]

It also must interface with ESW for the code.
